meta.name: tool-calling-tutor
meta.description: Use when a tool-calling agent does not call a tool, sends wrong arguments, loops without stopping, or needs a function schema. Guides a four-branch diagnosis and five-step schema repair. Do not use for framework-specific, MCP-server, or production-observability questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 修复智能体工具调用失灵与参数报错
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的AI智能体总是不调用工具或传错参数,需要定位根因
copy.tagline_en: Fix AI tool-calling failures and wrong arguments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're debugging an AI agent that fails to call tools or passes wrong arguments

howto.what: 引导你为函数调用类问题分四类诊断：模型不调工具、参数传错、循环不停、从零设计 schema；随后按对应路线检查 description、参数类型、循环控制或走五步设计法，并给出好/坏写法对照和 SDK 差异表。它不会替你写代码。
howto.when: 当你做函数调用类 Agent 时模型不调用工具、参数传错、循环停不下来，或需要设计函数参数规格时触发；框架相关、MCP 服务器、生产监控问题不会接管。

say.text: 我的 Agent 一直不调用工具，直接文字回答，帮我排查。
say.note: 它会让你从四种症状里选一种，再分步诊断。

say.text: ReAct 循环跑不停，是不是 messages 忘加回去了？
say.note: 它会按 control flow 分支检查常见原因。

howto.what_en: Guides the user through a four-branch diagnostic for tool-calling issues plus a five-step schema design process. It asks which of four symptoms applies, then walks through checks with bad/good schema references and an SDK-diff table. It does not write code for the user.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a user building a tool-calling agent reports the LLM does not call a tool, sends wrong arguments, loops endlessly, or needs a function schema. Not for framework-specific, MCP-server, or production-observability questions.

say_en.text: My agent never calls tools and just answers in text. Help me debug.
say_en.note: It asks you to pick one of four symptoms, then guides diagnosis.

say_en.text: My function schema keeps passing wrong args; I typed everything as string. How do I fix it?
say_en.note: It guides you to fix types, required, and enums in the schema.

say_en.text: My ReAct loop never stops. Did I forget to add the assistant message back?
say_en.note: It checks common causes in the control-flow branch.
